findings.message: Element "end" (endEvent) has 3 incoming flows. Non-gateway elements must have at most one incoming flow.
findings.suggestion: Add an exclusive gateway before this element to join the incoming flows.

findings.message: Start event "S" has no documentation describing expected input variables.
findings.suggestion: Add documentation listing the process input variables so callers know the expected contract.

findings.message: Variable "x" is referenced but never set in this process.
findings.suggestion: "x" is never set on any path through this process.
